app.title: Methane Data Screening Toolkit
region.title: Region
region.drawing: Click two corners on the map
region.none: No region yet. Draw a rectangle to load plumes.
time.title: Time window
layers.title: Layers
layers.carbonmapper.freshness: Facility-scale plumes from Tanager, EMIT, and aircraft. Published after provider review.
layers.mars.freshness: Satellite plumes across EMIT, TROPOMI, Sentinel-2, Landsat, EnMAP, PRISMA. Public 30 days after detection; export refreshed monthly.
layers.tropomi.freshness: Patch-based ultra-emitter screening of Sentinel-5P XCH4. Facility-scale detections from other layers are independent of these 0.05° patches.
layers.ghgsat.freshness: Dogniaux et al. 2021–2022 landfill plumes. Archive ignores the time window.
layers.cusworth.freshness: US landfill aircraft campaign (2016–2022) with GHGRP IDs. Archive ignores the time window.
layers.ghgrp_us.freshness: Latest EPA GHGRP reporting year. CH4 from tCO2e with GWP 25. Archive ignores the time window.
layers.ghgrp_ca.freshness: Latest ECCC GHGRP reference year. Reported CH4 tonnes. Archive ignores the time window.
layers.nesser.freshness: TROPOMI inversion posteriors for 70 US landfills. Archive ignores the time window.
layers.canada_nir.freshness: 0.1° Scarpelli inventory cells ≥ 1 kg/hr (waste, wastewater, residential, oil/gas leakage).
layers.methanesat.freshness: Layer listing only. Raw L3/L4 stay on Google Earth Engine / Google Cloud (request-gated). This app does not redistribute them.
layers.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total}. Narrow the region or time window.
list.title: Plumes
list.empty: No plumes for the enabled layers in this region and time window.
detail.title: Selected plume
detail.empty: Select a plume on the map or in the list.
detail.noImage: No image published for this plume.
detail.independent: Independent facility-scale observation with the provider's stated uncertainty. Non-commercial use.
detail.campaign: Aircraft campaign detection with the provider's stated uncertainty. Not a live catalog.
detail.facility: Annual self-reported inventory converted to kg/hr. Not a plume detection.
detail.inversion: 2019 TROPOMI inversion posterior, not a daily plume snapshot.
detail.grid: 0.1° inventory cell from the 2018 Canada NIR (Scarpelli et al.).
detail.methanesat: Data from MethaneSAT. Download the most current dataset at Google Earth Engine and/or Google Cloud. Raw L3/L4 are not served here.
credentials.title: Copernicus credential manager
credentials.help: Keys stay in local AWS_Keys.txt and are not uploaded. Generate S3 keys at the Copernicus S3 keys manager.
tropomi.title: TROPOMI screening
news.title: Methane news
news.empty: Draw a region to load methane news.
news.none: No recent methane headlines for this region.
news.attribution: Headlines via Google News RSS. Link through to the publisher. Not detections.
